inference.holm_family: two comparators within each model seed and separately for pooled seed-first inference
inference.pooled_seed_first: average comparator-minus-kinetic TB-MSE effects across model seeds within each transcript before pooled bootstrap and sign-flip inference
inference.per_seed_condition: for each comparator and every model seed, effect > 0, bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, and two-comparator Holm p < 0.05
inference.joint_development_condition: both comparators satisfy every per-seed condition and the pooled seed-first bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 with two-comparator Holm p < 0.05

note: This records the verifier's existing stricter criteria before outer results; it is not a post-hoc analysis choice and does not change the frozen protocol or Gate.
